title: 第一卷 第9章 清醒
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

弹幕已经刷疯。

【哈哈哈哈第二题又一致！】

【这对CP怎么不甜但很好笑。】

【我宣布他俩是财务型情侣。】

【情侣默契挑战变成劳动合同考试。】

顾南舟脸色更差了。

他不明白。

宋尔尔以前明明不是这样的。

她曾经也会因为他迟到而生气，会问他是不是不在乎她，会等他的解释。

现在她只会写两个字。

第三题，主持人终于露出一丝看热闹的笑。

“如果必须用一个词形容对方，你会写什么？”

这个问题一出来，弹幕立刻兴奋。

【来了来了！】

【陆执会写什么？有趣？真实？特别？】

【宋尔尔不会写有钱吧？】

【前面的，你很懂她。】

林栀和顾南舟先翻。

林栀写的是：认真。

顾南舟写的是：温柔。

主持人满意点头：“两位对彼此的印象都很正面。”

林栀微微低头，笑得恰到好处。

顾南舟看了她一眼，又下意识去看宋尔尔。

宋尔尔没看他。

她在甩马克笔。

周闻野写姜眠：胆小。

姜眠写周闻野：直接。

周闻野看见“直接”两个字，明显松了口气：“比胆小好听。”

姜眠小声：“胆小也没事，我确实有点。”

宋尔尔开口：“胆小不是缺点，乱吓人才是缺德。”

姜眠愣了一下。

她抿唇笑了笑。

陆执看了宋尔尔一眼。

她说这话的时候表情很随意，像只是顺口。

但他发现，宋尔尔每次开玩笑，都有自己的边界。

她怼顾南舟，怼节目组，怼主持人，但她从来不拿真正软弱的人开刀。

这点很少有人注意到。

轮到他们。

主持人语气都兴奋了些：“来，让我们看看尔尔和陆老师会怎么形容彼此。”

宋尔尔先翻板。

上面写着：贵。

陆执低头看了一眼，没说话。

主持人：“贵？”

宋尔尔点头：“整体都挺贵，脸贵，衣服贵，出场费估计更贵。”

主持人问：“这是夸奖吗？”

宋尔尔：“当然，便宜没好货，好货不便宜。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The barrage has gone crazy.

[Hahahaha, the second question is the same again!】

[This couple is not sweet but very funny.】

[I declare that they are a financial couple.】

[The couple's tacit understanding challenge turns into a labor contract exam.】

Gu Nanzhou's expression turned even worse.

He doesn't understand.

Song Er'er was obviously not like this before.

She used to be angry because he was late, would ask him if he didn't care about her, and would wait for his explanation.

Now she can only write two words.

For the third question, the host finally showed a hint of fun-loving smile.

“If you had to describe the other person in one word, what would you write?”

As soon as this question came out, the barrage immediately became excited.

【Coming, coming!】

[What will Director Lu write?interesting?reality?special?】

[Song Er’er doesn’t know how to write about being rich, right?】

[As mentioned above, you understand her very well.】

Lin Zhi and Gu Nanzhou turned over first.

Lin Zhi wrote: Seriously.

Gu Nanzhou wrote: gentleness.

The host nodded with satisfaction: "Both of you have a very positive impression of each other."

Lin Zhi lowered his head slightly and smiled just right.

Gu Nanzhou glanced at her, then subconsciously looked at Song Er'er.

Song Er'er didn't look at him.

She's shaking the marker.

Zhou Wenye wrote that Jiang Mian was timid.

Jiang Mian writes about Zhou Wenye: direct.

When Zhou Wenye saw the word "direct", he was visibly relieved: "It sounds better than timid."

Jiang Mian whispered: "It's okay to be timid, I do have some."

Song Er'er said: "Being timid is not a shortcoming, but scaring people is a bad virtue."

Jiang Mian was stunned for a moment.

She pursed her lips and smiled.

Lu Zhi glanced at Song Er'er.

When she said this, her expression was very casual, as if she was just speaking smoothly.

But he found that Song Erer had his own boundaries every time he joked.

She criticized Gu Nanzhou, the program team, and the host, but she never attacked the really weak people.

Few people notice this.

It's their turn.

The host's tone became more excited: "Come on, let's see how Er'er and Teacher Lu would describe each other."

Song Er'er flipped the board first.

It says: Expensive.

Lu Zhi glanced down and said nothing.

Host: "Expensive?"

Song Er'er nodded: "The whole thing is quite expensive, the face is expensive, the clothes are expensive, and the appearance fee is probably even more expensive."

The host asked: "Is this a compliment?"

Song Er'er: "Of course, good products are not cheap, and good products are not cheap."
